{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "secp256k1 build changes are bundled inside the vendored subtree and do not alter Bitcoin Core build or CI infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates to build secp256k1 modules do not make this a build system change."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to doc/descriptors.md and doc/psbt.md directly follow the code additions rather than being standalone documentation work.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes purely document the new CISA descriptor and PSBT features."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touch to src/kernel/chainparams.cpp only configures regtest activation parameters without altering the kernel API or boundary.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Touches validation and chainparams code compiling into the kernel without affecting kernel boundaries or public interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Policy adjustments in src/policy/policy.cpp define standardness rules for witness v2 spends accompanying the consensus proposal.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Mempool standardness rules are secondary additions following the proposed consensus specification."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch block template construction, getblocktemplate, or the Mining interface.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mining logic is unaffected."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No modifications to P2P transport, connection handling, or transaction relay protocols.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "P2P network behavior remains unchanged."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC additions in rawtransaction and blockchain merely expose witness v2 and CISA data structures.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR only exposes consensus and descriptor features through RPC without modifying RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test harness helpers in test_framework/cisa.py are specific to testing CISA functionality rather than generic framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Feature-specific tests belong to their functional areas."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Vendors unmerged experimental modules in src/secp256k1 rather than an upstream release subtree update.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The secp256k1 modifications serve as dependencies for the consensus proposal rather than general utility improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements consensus script verification and check queue validation for witness version 2 outputs under BIP460.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides the reference consensus validation logic for Cross-Input Signature Aggregation (CISA). The underlying problem—that 'every Taproot key path spend requires an individual 64-byte Schnorr signature, increasing transaction size and fees linearly' and penalizing collaborative transactions—is strategically important to evaluate through review of the consensus verification rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds `cisa()` descriptor parsing, PSBT serialization fields, and wallet signing support for BIP458/459 signature aggregation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds wallet signing, descriptor, and PSBT support for Taproot key path aggregation. While it provides a clear reference implementation for collaborative wallet transactions, review is reasonably deferrable as the feature is experimental and restricted to regtest."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
